email_subject: Application - Social Media Expert at NTT DATA
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media Expert role with NTT DATA, supporting the European Commission in Brussels. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to impactful European projects.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and launched a multi-page site with full social media integration (Instagram/Facebook), implemented structured data, and ran technical audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and have a strong focus on data-driven reporting.

I am autonomous, detail-oriented, and thrive in collaborative, multicultural environments. My English is at a professional level, and I am quickly learning Dutch. I am excited about the opportunity to translate complex policy into engaging social content and to grow within your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Expert position at NTT DATA, supporting the European Commission in Brussels. Your focus on creating daily content, managing online communities, and using analytics to optimize social strategies aligns perfectly with my skills and interests.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for client websites. I also track performance using Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads, which has sharpened my ability to interpret data and tell the story behind the numbers. On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and launched a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, integrating social media (Instagram and Facebook) and implementing structured data to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience taught me how to autonomously research content, translate complex topics into understandable language, and monitor social performance.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to collaborate with internal teams and external multipliers to design social media strategies and measurement frameworks. My background in SEO and GEO gives me a unique perspective on how content performs across platforms, and I am eager to apply this to the European Commission's objectives. I am autonomous, organized, and detail-oriented, with excellent verbal communication skills. I work in English at a professional level and am improving my Dutch.

I would welcome the chance to contribute to your team and to grow professionally while making an impact from day one. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
